answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 8203 Country: Canada Title: To what extent can a friendship with a girl or woman progress for a Muslim man in Islam? Question: To what extent can a friendship with a girl or woman progress for a Muslim man in Islam? Answer ID: 8203 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1873/289=TB/1429) Islam does not allow any kind of friendship between a man and a strange girl or a woman. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
